name: Dalar's Analysis
summary: In Silverpine, Allister's report sends a Dalaran relic to Dalar for study. A rune-inscribed pendant taken from a supply crate reaches Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher. The relic shows that Dalaran's surviving mages are gathering great magical power for a hidden purpose.

sections.title: A Courier's Cargo
sections.body: A supply crate from Dalaran is raided at a camp north of Pyrewood Village. Beneath old maps, Shadow Priest Allister finds a rune-inscribed pendant. Its enchantment is beyond his spiritual knowledge, so he sends it to Dalar Dawnweaver at the Sepulcher. Dalar's skill as an arcane scholar makes him better suited to read Dalaran's magical warding.

sections.title: Kirin Tor Machinations
sections.body: Dalar Dawnweaver finds the pendant is a specialized conduit once favored by high-ranking Kirin Tor wizards. It lets them channel potent magic. Many such relics are being sent straight to fortified Ambermill, a sign that the wizards are preparing an undertaking on a vast scale. Dalar probes their wards to learn their intentions.

faq.answer: The pendant is an arcane conduit that senior Kirin Tor mages use to channel large amounts of magical energy safely. Found in transit, it suggests Ambermill is receiving powerful foci for high-level spellcraft.

faq.q: Why does Shadow Priest Allister send the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver?
faq.answer: Shadow Priest Allister handles shadow magic and gathers intelligence for the Forsaken at the Sepulcher. Since the pendant is a complex arcane relic made in Dalaran, he sends it to Dalar Dawnweaver to inspect its runes and determine its purpose.

faq.q: Where is Ambermill and why are the Forsaken monitoring it?
faq.answer: Ambermill is a fortified human town in southeastern Silverpine Forest, maintained by Dalaran's mages. Deep in territory claimed by Lady Sylvanas Windrunner, it poses a military and magical threat to the Forsaken, who keep close watch on its borders.

faq.q: What happens after Dalar analyzes the pendant?
faq.answer: Dalar recognizes that the Kirin Tor are gathering conduits for a major undertaking. In Dalaran's Intentions, the following task, he uses magic to scry through Ambermill's defensive shields and discover what the wizards are planning.

faq.q: Where can Dalar Dawnweaver be found?
faq.answer: Dalar Dawnweaver can be found inside the crypt at the Sepulcher, the Forsaken's main stronghold in Silverpine Forest, along the main road.

faq.q: Why are the Kirin Tor operating openly in Silverpine Forest?
faq.answer: Before the Scourge devastated Lordaeron, Ambermill was a quiet lumber town. Though the capital and Dalaran fell, surviving wizards made Ambermill an active redoubt, where they constantly clash with Forsaken expansion.

angles.text: As a Forsaken mage, you may recognize the Kirin Tor pendant as a traditional Dalaran spellweaving tool. Its presence suggests your old brethren are preparing an immense invocation.
As Forsaken, you help monitor Dalaran's operations at Ambermill to guard Silverpine's borders and protect the Sepulcher from hostile sorcery.
As Horde, you help thwart the Kirin Tor's projects in Silverpine, keeping the Eastern Kingdoms secure from resurgent Alliance-aligned magical factions.
